_comment: Automated dependency PRs. Round 22 found 2 CRITICAL CVEs already shipped (Clerk middleware bypass, Next.js HTTP request smuggling). Without Renovate, the next CVE lands in production the same way — silently. With it, a PR opens within an hour of the upstream patch.

vulnerabilityAlerts._comment: Security alerts ALWAYS open a PR immediately, ignoring the schedule. CRITICAL upgrades skip the queue entirely.

packageRules._comment: Group Next.js + React + related into one PR — they version together
Group Clerk packages — they release together
Auto-merge patch + minor bumps in dev-dependencies. They can't break prod runtime.
Lock files and tooling - allow auto-merge for patches
Major bumps NEVER auto-merge. Require human review (breaking changes possible).

lockFileMaintenance._comment: Refresh package-lock.json weekly to capture transitive-dep CVE patches even when our top-level pins haven't changed.
